decision_reason: Only 17 of 1716428 bureau rows (0.0010%) have DAYS_CREDIT_UPDATE > 0 (max +372 days), and all of them are already-Active loans whose DAYS_CREDIT (origination) is confirmed <= 0. Filtering these out would not measurably change any aggregate. DAYS_CREDIT_UPDATE is reported for transparency, not used as a row-inclusion filter in build_bureau_aggregates().
